newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tysan sells building for HK$127.7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Tysan sells building for HK$127.7 mln.

text.p: Tysan Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it had agreed to sell one of its investment properties located at King's Road and Tong Chong Street, eastern Hong Kong, for HK$127.7 million and will report an exceptional profit of HK$41.0 million from the sale.
It said the HK$41.0 million, before tax and costs, will be reported as exceptional profit in the year to March 31, 1997.
Tysan said total consideration from the sale, after a bank legal charge of about HK$21.0 million, will generate net surplus cash of about HK$106.7 million.
Tysan said it intends to use the net proceeds of the sale for future investments in property and general working capital.
